$comment: Cases both editors must judge alike. Each case is a source and the issues expected for it, sorted by start, end and code; offsets count UTF-16 code units. An issue without start and end is checked by code only: the two JavaScript parsers do not always place a syntax error on the same character. fixes holds the whole source after each quick fix, in the order offered.
